title: Cem Karsan Explains the Best Two-Week Window to Sell Volatility
speaker: Cem Karsan (guest, tastylive)

macro_themes.view: This week into Friday's monthly options expiration is the best window to sell volatility; markets hard to move, realized vol suppressed.
Structural risk around the midterms and a possibly contested election is at odds with mechanical vol-selling flows, driving dispersion.
Host notes CPI and OpEx are the week's big events; no CPI call given.

calls.condition: Vol compression runs through Friday's monthly OpEx (five-week cycle, no VIX expiration this week); midterms/contested election risk sits behind it
calls.reason: Dealers get longer vega daily (vomma/veta) in the 1.5 weeks before monthly OpEx, forcing vol selling, compressing implied and realized vol; calendars (short Oct, long Nov) are favored.
calls.quote: by far the best V compressing times in history on a cycle option cycle basis are the week and a half leading into options expirations

notes: Short clip; no price levels. 'Set the table for the week' suggests it may be from Mon Oct 12 rather than the listing date of Oct 13. Implied short-term view: low/compressing volatility into OpEx (Fri Oct 16); no explicit index direction.
